title: Multiplicativity under random restrictions
statement: Let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$ be a sign-valued Boolean function, let $k\\in\\mathbb N$, and let $0\\le\\delta_1,\\delta_2\\le 1$. Then $P_{\\delta_1\\delta_2,k}(f)$ equals the average, over a first random restriction at parameter $\\delta_1$, of the switching-failure probability at parameter $\\delta_2$ and threshold $k$ for the resulting function on its free coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the sign cube with sign-valued output
